crossRefs.note: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from…
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am…
Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at…
to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and…
when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because…
Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
translations.bsb: She added, “Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”
translations.kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
translations.asv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? For I have borne him a son in his old age.
